review: The Hohenheim Gregor ID is a complicated one to approach. His damage while is fine, but it is not good enough. His Status Infliction is mediocre and he doesn’t really provide any value for them. As such, the most “rewarding” use case for him is using him for SP Heal, attack redirection and enemy stat reduction, given his numerous effects that don’t do much on their own. Starting with his unique effects, he has: - “Lamp” gives Hohenheim Gregor, Bind, based on the stack, which is only used to fulfill his conditionals consistently. When he reaches 8 stacks, he gains 10 Aggro and inflicts 3 “Dazzle” on the enemy. - Dazzle - applies up to the equivalent of 1 Fragile based on the sum of Burn and Sinking on the enemy.
